physical_geography: Weigelt island namepoints with latitude and longitude (11,546 records), not all 17,883 island geometries
focal_nodes: Only the 3,878 v1.221 high-confidence one-to-one matched Structural islands; all distances computed in Weigelt WGS84 namepoint coordinate system

neighbour_sets.full_namepoint: all 11,546 source Weigelt points with location, exclude focal point itself
neighbour_sets.represented: only the 3,878 v1.221 confidently matched Structural points, exclude focal point itself
neighbour_sets.unrepresented: all geocoded Weigelt points not in the 3,878 matched set; DOES NOT mean mammal-free

distance_endpoints: fraction of focal nodes for which nearest neighbour in full namepoint reference is not a confidently matched Structural node
median and IQR of full-namepoint nearest and matched-set nearest distances (km)
median and IQR of ratio nearest matched / nearest full (>=1, handle exact coordinate duplicates by hard STOP)
fraction of focal nodes where matching-set nearest distance exceeds reference nearest by >5 km
median number unrepresented Weigelt geocoded locations within 10 km and 25 km per focal node
same fraction of nearest unrepresented and distance inflation by selected island area bins below 10,10-100,>=100 km2
reliability_caveat: Historical Weigelt named point may differ from island centroid or polygon location; 6,337 Weigelt rows lack namepoints; mutual matching criterion preferentially retains certain island sizes. This reports geometric opportunity only among geocoded geography, not causal removal of mammal-zero islands.
technical_test_key_fix: Correct frozen v1.221 test ledger path matched_selected_geographic_candidates instead of nonexistent matched_selected_Structural_islands; no physical-neighbour statistic changed.
